name: Put Christmas Tree Butterfly (1-3-2)
summary: Buy 1 put at C (highest), sell 3 puts at B, buy 2 puts at A (lowest) with equal spacing; the put-side 1-3-2, tilted mildly bearish with the tent centered at B.

legs.strike_rule: B = C - W where W = 1.0-1.5% of spot; B delta -0.25 to -0.35
A = B - W (identical spacing); A delta -0.12 to -0.20

when_to_use: IV rank > 35 with a mild bearish drift thesis. Put skew makes the 2 long A puts relatively expensive, so this version usually costs more than its call twin - price both and choose.
max_profit: (W x 100) - net debit, at strike B
max_loss: net debit on the upside; the trough between A and B must be evaluated numerically per fill and is the true max loss
breakevens: upper breakeven = C - debit/100; lower breakeven between B and A, solved numerically

greeks.delta: negative at entry (-10 to -25 per unit)
greeks.theta: positive when spot is above B

entry_rules: Strike spacing C->B and B->A exactly equal.
Strict 1:3:2 contract ratio so net contracts = 0 and no naked short exists.
Full expiry payoff computed at A, B, C and 2W below A before submission; reject if the trough exceeds 1.5% of equity.
OI >= 500 per strike, per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 10% of mid).
Single 6-contract multi-leg order at mid, pay up to mid + $0.04.
management_rules: Close at 21 DTE regardless of P/L.
Close if spot trades below A.
Stop at 60% of the debit if spot rallies above C.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: 3 short puts at B. Flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if the B puts are ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.
assignment_risk: Three short puts at B: assignment buys 300 shares per unit at B, offset by 1 long at C and 2 at A. On a $600 ETF that is $180k of stock against a $50k account - an instant margin call. This is the largest single-structure share-delivery exposure in the family.
buying_power: Net debit plus the spread requirement on the decomposed short put spreads; budget (W x 100) + debit per unit.
common_mistakes: Unequal spacing creating hidden naked exposure; ignoring the payoff trough below B; carrying 3 short puts into expiry week on an index ETF.
zero_dte_notes: Not recommended - same reasons as the call version, and the share-delivery exposure is worse on the put side.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
